# codex-work-watch

Agent entrypoint for monitoring Codex and ChatGPT Work changes.

Read order:
1. manifest.yaml
2. AGENTS.md
3. prompts/codex-work-watch.zh-CN.md
4. policies/*
5. state/schema.yaml

Purpose:
High-signal monitoring of availability, routing, credits, usage limits, releases and reset lifecycle.

Default behavior:
Silent unless notification thresholds are met.
